description: Violations of Advisory guidelines are recorded (a formal deviation is not required, but the decision is documented).
name: misra_cpp_advisory_violation_recorded

description: A Guidelines Compliance Summary (GCS) is produced as the primary record of overall project compliance.
name: misra_cpp_compliance_summary_produced

description: Every deviation records the violation and its supporting rationale, and is approved through the deviation procedure.
name: misra_cpp_deviation_documented

description: Directives (process/design guidelines, whose compliance depends on project context) are addressed with documented evidence.
name: misra_cpp_directives_addressed

description: Each guideline analysed has a defined enforcement means in the Guidelines Enforcement Plan.
name: misra_cpp_enforcement_plan_defined

description: A Mandatory guideline is never re-categorized to a less strict category; only Advisory guidelines may be re-categorized to Disapplied.
name: misra_cpp_mandatory_not_weakened

description: No deviation is raised against a Mandatory guideline.
name: misra_cpp_no_mandatory_deviation

description: Mandatory guidelines are never violated — no deviation is permitted against a Mandatory guideline.
name: misra_cpp_no_mandatory_violation

description: Any change to a guideline's category is documented in the Guidelines Re-categorization Plan (GRP).
name: misra_cpp_recategorization_in_grp

description: Any violation of a Required guideline is covered by an approved deviation.
name: misra_cpp_required_violation_deviated

description: Source is checked against the MISRA C++:2023 ruleset by static analysis before it is committed.
name: misra_cpp_static_analysis_before_commit

description: Potential violations of undecidable guidelines (not fully checkable by static analysis) are subject to manual review.
name: misra_cpp_undecidable_manually_reviewed
